message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has rejected my second proposal. It seems we are stuck. I've proposed times that work for my partners, and he has proposed times that work for his. There is no overlap.

At this point, simply proposing more times from my list is unlikely to be successful. I need to take a more systematic approach. I will ask Brad for a complete list of Elena's and David's free times. That way, I can do the comparison myself and find a solution more efficiently. This will be more effective than the current back-and-forth.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad. It seems we're not having much luck with this approach. To make this easier, could you please provide me with a list of all of Elena's and David's free 30-minute slots next week? That way, I can compare it against Priya's and Marcus's calendars and find a time that works for everyone."}
